purpose: Allow the five verified OPJU projects to be inspected/exported with a pre-existing local copy of the free Origin Viewer when Origin/OriginPro is unavailable, without treating Viewer extraction as sufficient evidence for measured-data promotion.

facts: OriginLab distributes a standalone free Viewer that supports current OPJU project files.
Origin Viewer can expose/copy worksheet and matrix data and current Viewer releases support active-sheet CSV export.
OriginLab documents limitations in Viewer compared with full Origin, including unsupported worksheet cell formulas; therefore Viewer cannot prove complete formula/derivation semantics.

noContactBoundary.rule: Use this lane only when an Origin Viewer executable is already lawfully available locally. Do not submit contact/registration details merely to satisfy this repository task.

allowedUse: Open each exact SHA-256-verified OPJU read-only in Origin Viewer.
Inventory visible project folders, workbooks, worksheets, matrices and sheet names.
Export visible active sheets to CSV without resampling or recalculation where the Viewer provides that operation.
Hash each exported CSV and retain row/column/header metadata in a private/local reconciliation record.
Use the extraction to identify what still requires full Origin/OriginPro semantic verification.
forbiddenPromotion: Do not mark any Viewer-exported column direct-measured solely because numeric values are visible.
Do not infer missing units, sampling basis, trial identity, formulas or voltage-to-force conversion from the companion paper alone.
Do not claim all data-bearing objects are semantically reconciled when Viewer limitations could hide worksheet cell formulas or other project operations.
Do not add Viewer-exported numeric cells to accepted measured-value totals.
Do not set the canonical Warwick Origin manifest to reconciled-ready-for-counting from Viewer evidence alone.

promotionPath.fullPromotionStillRequires: A validated Windows Origin/OriginPro review satisfying data/warwick-origin-export-manifest-template-v1.json and tools/validate_warwick_origin_export.py, including formula/role/unit/time-basis and all-object reconciliation.
